source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The change removes remote browsers from the legacy DOM-link listener path and removes specialTabs default-favicon guessing. Nonremote browsers still register those listeners, with a comment explaining chrome documents, and the legacy setter remains. LinkHandlerParent also limits itself to a content tab and rechecks browser membership after asynchronous conversion. Preserve those boundaries instead of treating the title as universal single-setter ownership.
title: Remote content-tab icon handling leaves an explicit nonremote DOM-link path
